articles.title_en: Man City dump Brighton out of Carabao Cup after shoot-out victory
articles.title_ja: Man City dump ブライトン out of Carabao Cup after shoot-out victory
articles.summary_ja: Carabao Cup holders Manchester City needed penalties to progress past ブライトン and into the quarter-finals after battling from behind to draw the game 2-2 at the Etihad.
